in_marathi.name: Keertan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Keertan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Keertan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Keer’, which means 'praise' or 'glorify'. The suffix ‘tan’ denotes one who chants or recites sacred texts. Thus, Keertan signifies one who sings the praises of God or engages in devotional practices.
